request.subject: UNIT:CULT:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the colour of the cloth: recolour the dark grey-blue hood and robe to a clear bright indigo, a violet-leaning blue, colour #4a43b5 on the lit left side and #372f8f in the folds and on the shaded right side. Keep the two big round cream eyes, the candle with its small green flame, the cream paper scroll, the brass badge, the cream slippers, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
